roadmap.title: Finish the main story
roadmap.description: Complete all 17 main missions on any difficulty, buying one skill and one armor upgrade when convenient.

roadmap.title: Post-story region cleanup
roadmap.description: Use free roam and the region trackers to collect every required item, finish Favors, craft equipment, and reach gear level 9.

roadmap.title: Defeat the endgame bosses
roadmap.description: Finish the Berserker Gravestones, defeat King Hrólf and Gná, then confirm every base-game achievement.

roadmap.title: Complete Valhalla
roadmap.description: Run the separate Valhalla mode through its six chapters, rotating starting weapons and Masteries before cleaning up The Forum, Echoes, cosmetics, and Boat Captain Keys.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Unlock the other @mechanic{35 base-game achievements}; the 12 Valhalla achievements are not required.

guide.context: The base-game completion set has no online or difficulty-specific requirement.

steps.text: Finish every other base-game achievement. The Bear and the Wolf registers when the thirty-fifth remaining base entry unlocks.

achievements.description: Collect one flower from each of the nine realms.
achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Collect all @item{9 flowers} for Nine Realms in Bloom, including both Niflheim flowers.

guide.context: The first pickup starts the Favor. Several flowers and three destination Gateways require story completion, so the route is safest in post-story free roam.

collectibles.name: Ashpetal
collectibles.method: Collect Ashpetal beside Brok’s shop after opening Muspelheim with the two Seed Pieces from Modvitnir’s Rig and Alberich Hollow.

collectibles.name: Dawnbloom
collectibles.method: Search the far-west rocks below the climbable platform for Dawnbloom.

collectibles.name: Dreamshade
collectibles.method: After the story, take the newly opened route beside The Raven Tree into Aesir Prison Wreckage. Dreamshade is inside a cell on the lowest floor.

collectibles.name: Frostfinger
collectibles.method: After the story, obtain Ratatoskr’s Yggdrasil Seed, use the Mist Fields Gateway, and collect Frostfinger beside it.

collectibles.name: Ironbell
collectibles.method: Use Ratatoskr’s post-story Yggdrasil Seed to reach Angrboda’s Treehouse, then follow the side path to Ironbell.

collectibles.name: Mirkweed
collectibles.method: Use Ratatoskr’s post-story Yggdrasil Seed and collect Mirkweed beside Freya’s house.

collectibles.name: Soulblossom
collectibles.method: After the second Garm encounter, use Draupnir on the gap to the right before the climb and cross to Soulblossom.

collectibles.name: Sparkthorn
collectibles.method: Near the tavern, use Draupnir to cross the gap and collect Sparkthorn from the ground.

collectibles.name: Starblush
collectibles.method: Complete Return of the River, then collect Starblush south of The Sinkholes Mystic Gateway.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Collect all @item{14 Kvasir’s Poems} across Svartalfheim, Midgard, Alfheim, and Vanaheim.

guide.context: Every Book is also an Artifact, nothing is missable, and the full route assumes all post-story traversal tools.

collectibles.name: The Sunrise of Nothingness
collectibles.method: On the last island, collect the poem from the table beside the story chain above the geyser elevator.

collectibles.name: Sanguinity
collectibles.method: From the Sverd Sands elevator, use Draupnir to climb the first wall, turn left, and detonate the spear rubble.

collectibles.name: Tool and Bang
collectibles.method: By the Berserker Gravestone, redirect the water to move the crane block, freeze the channel while riding it, and jump to the hill behind the crane.

collectibles.name: Large Society Ground Orb, The Performance
collectibles.method: After receiving Sonic Arrows, destroy the green barrier on the left dock and take the poem behind it.

collectibles.name: We Who Remain, Part the Second
collectibles.method: Climb two walls, turn left, and follow the upper route to the island’s summit.

collectibles.name: The Dead Do Not Ride
collectibles.method: Pull the large chain, return through the starting area, and climb the newly opened wall route.

collectibles.name: Afterlife Abandonment
collectibles.method: Leave the short cave, drop from the ledge ahead, and collect the poem beside the Legendary Chest on the left.

collectibles.name: Visions After Rest
collectibles.method: At the top of the spiral staircase, turn right before the arch and climb the wall.

collectibles.name: Spirits Within Walls
collectibles.method: Turn the wooden wheel after Kratos opens the gate, climb back up, and check the left side beyond the next arch.

collectibles.name: Celestial Construct
collectibles.method: Enter the dragon skull in the region’s northeast and climb its rear wall.

collectibles.name: Trip
collectibles.method: Climb the small tower in the region’s northeast and collect the poem at its top.

collectibles.name: The Southern Wilds Kvasir’s Poem
collectibles.method: Climb the central tower among the poison sacks, then break through the blue-marked floor.

collectibles.name: An Organisation: In The Future
collectibles.method: At night, take the southwest Crater tunnel and collect the poem after its climbing section.

collectibles.name: Eastern Spectre
collectibles.method: Defeat the drake, burn the red vines, and squeeze through the revealed gap.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Collect the @item{38 standalone Artifacts} and finish all @mechanic{5 Casualties of War} in Vanaheim’s Crater.

guide.context: The five Casualties contain two Favor items each and count toward this achievement in addition to the region-tracked purple Artifacts.

collectibles.name: Svartalfheim — 11 Artifacts
collectibles.method: Clear the Artifact counters in Aurvangar Wetlands, The Applecore, Jarnsmida Pitmines, Nidavellir, The Forge, and Lyngbakr Island.

collectibles.name: Midgard — 7 Artifacts
collectibles.method: Clear the Shores of Nine, The Oarsmen, The Derelict Outpost, and Lake of Nine Artifact counters.

collectibles.name: Alfheim — 11 Artifacts
collectibles.method: Clear The Strond, Temple of Light, The Barrens, The Burrows, and The Forbidden Sands Artifact counters.

collectibles.name: Vanaheim — 9 Artifacts
collectibles.method: Clear The Southern Wilds, Freyr’s Camp, Noatunn’s Garden, The Veiled Passage, Vanir Shrine, River Delta, The Jungle, and The Sinkholes counters.

collectibles.name: Casualty of War: The Stein
collectibles.method: Take one half at The Jungle water wheel and the other from The Plains Dreki arena.

collectibles.name: Casualty of War: The Toy
collectibles.method: Take one half on the Mystic Gateway island and the second after defeating the ogres on their island.

collectibles.name: Casualty of War: The Hourglass
collectibles.method: Find the first half along the dragon route beyond the Gateway and the second in the later tunnel leading toward the dragon boss.

collectibles.name: Casualty of War: The Brooch
collectibles.method: Collect one half near the center of The Plains and defeat the cliff miniboss guarding the other.

collectibles.name: Casualty of War: The Scroll
collectibles.method: Start from the spirit in the northwestern cave, then detonate all three Draupnir weak points near the Gateway to uncover the second half.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: During @loc{The Reckoning}, defeat @enemy{Níðhögg}, craft the tutorial Enchantment, and equip it in the Amulet.

guide.context: The tutorial is mandatory story progress after the boss and cannot be skipped.

steps.text: Follow the equipment prompt, craft the displayed Amulet Enchantment, select an open slot, and equip it before continuing.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: At any blacksmith, buy one level upgrade for a chest, wrist, or waist armor piece.

guide.context: Only one upgrade is required; the armor does not need to reach its maximum level.

steps.text: Open the blacksmith’s Armor menu, select an owned piece with an available upgrade, and hold the displayed purchase input until its level increases.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Begin @loc{Reunion} after learning @mechanic{Fury}, @mechanic{Valor}, and @mechanic{Wrath}, the three Spartan Rage forms.

guide.context: All three forms are mandatory story unlocks, and the achievement registers when Main Mission 12 begins.

steps.text: Continue the main story until the Reunion mission title appears; no Rage form must be manually equipped.

achievements.description: Obtain all of the Apples of Iðunn and Horns of Blood Mead
achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Open all @item{35 Nornir Chests} to obtain every Apple of Iðunn and Horn of Blood Mead upgrade.

guide.context: Chest rewards depend on how many Nornir Chests have already been opened rather than on a fixed location.

steps.text: Finish the story to unlock every traversal ability needed for the Nornir puzzles.
Open the map for each realm and region, then solve Nornir Chests until every regional Nornir counter is complete.
Open the thirty-fifth Nornir Chest; its reward completes the remaining health or rage upgrade and registers the achievement.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Open @mechanic{Skills} and spend XP on any unlocked skill node.

guide.context: Story missions, Favors, and side activities all award the XP used for skill purchases.

steps.text: Select an affordable skill in the Skills menu and hold the displayed purchase input until the node unlocks.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Björn}, the bear boss, during @loc{Surviving Fimbulwinter}.

guide.context: Björn is the mandatory first boss and can be defeated on any difficulty.

steps.text: Complete the mandatory boss encounter and continue until the achievement notification appears.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Complete the first battle against @enemy{Thor} during @loc{Surviving Fimbulwinter}.

guide.context: The God of Thunder encounter is mandatory and registers at the end of the fight.

steps.text: Complete the mandatory boss encounter and continue until the achievement notification appears.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Vanadís}, the mysterious Valkyrie, at the start of @loc{The Reckoning}.

guide.context: The fight is fixed story progress with no route or dialogue condition.

steps.text: Complete the mandatory boss encounter and continue until the achievement notification appears.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Níðhögg} during @loc{The Reckoning}.

guide.context: The mandatory boss fight directly precedes the Amulet tutorial.

steps.text: Complete the mandatory boss encounter and continue until the achievement notification appears.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Grýla} and destroy her cauldron during @loc{The Lost Sanctuary}.

guide.context: The cauldron destruction is the required conclusion of the boss encounter.

steps.text: Complete the mandatory boss encounter and continue until the achievement notification appears.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Garm} during @loc{Reunion}.

guide.context: Garm is a mandatory campaign boss and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Complete the mandatory boss encounter and continue until the achievement notification appears.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Heimdall} during @loc{Creatures of Prophecy}.

guide.context: The fight is mandatory and awards the achievement after Heimdall falls.

steps.text: Complete the mandatory boss encounter and continue until the achievement notification appears.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Hrist and Mist} during @loc{The Summoning}.

guide.context: This required dual-boss battle occurs near the end of the main story.

steps.text: Complete the mandatory boss encounter and continue until the achievement notification appears.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Obtain the @item{Dauntless}, @item{Stone Wall}, @item{Guardian}, @item{Shatter Star}, and @item{Onslaught Shields}.

guide.context: Only the five functional base Shields count; Rönds and cosmetic appearances are outside the requirement.

collectibles.name: Dauntless Shield
collectibles.method: Craft the Dauntless Shield from the Shields menu.

collectibles.name: Stone Wall Shield
collectibles.method: Craft the Stone Wall Shield from the Shields menu.

collectibles.name: Guardian Shield
collectibles.method: Continue Main Mission 09 until Brok restores the Guardian Shield.

collectibles.name: Shatter Star Shield
collectibles.method: Open the Legendary Chest in The Abandoned Village.

collectibles.name: Onslaught Shield
collectibles.method: Open its Legendary Chest during Main Mission 11; if missed, buy the Shield later for 7,500 Hacksilver.

achievements.description: Obtain all Relics and Sword Hilts
achievements.sortReason: Complete during post-story cleanup, preserving saves around unique hilt materials.
achievements.summary: Obtain all @item{14 Relics and Sword Hilts}, including the four Lost Page recipes and Motsognir’s Call.

guide.context: Unique materials or Relic credit can occasionally fail to register. Save before fighting Ormstunga, Gravel Belly, Olaf Nautson, Blatonn, the second Oath Guard, and the Raven Keeper; verify each reward under Weapons > Relics. Missed drops normally appear in the blue blacksmith chest.

collectibles.name: Hilt of Dainsleif
collectibles.method: Find a Lost Page, defeat Ormstunga in Alberich Hollow for Svefnthorn, and craft the Hilt.

collectibles.name: Hilt of Skofnung
collectibles.method: Defeat every Berserker, then defeat King Hrólf and collect his Hilt.

collectibles.name: Hilt of Angrvadall
collectibles.method: Find a Lost Page, finish The Desert Door for Skirnir’s Gambanteinn, and craft the Hilt.

collectibles.name: Hilt of Ridill
collectibles.method: Find a Lost Page, defeat Olaf Nautson during Animal Instincts for Crackle of Bilskirnir, and craft the Hilt.

collectibles.name: Glaive of Dodher
collectibles.method: Defeat Fiske in Main Mission 06 and collect the story reward.

collectibles.name: Huldra Project #9
collectibles.method: Open Special Items, select Relics, and spend 10,000 Hacksilver.

collectibles.name: Mystical Heirloom
collectibles.method: Use Draupnir on the ice wall southwest of Tyr’s Temple and take the Relic beside the frozen corpse.

collectibles.name: Hilt of Forsbrandr
collectibles.method: Destroy all 48 Ravens, open all six Raven Tree chests, defeat The Raven Keeper, and collect the Hilt.

collectibles.name: Hilt of Tyrfing
collectibles.method: Find a Lost Page, defeat Blatonn in The Abandoned Village for Nar’s Cup, and craft the Hilt.

collectibles.name: Talisman of Meign
collectibles.method: Pick up the mandatory Relic during Main Mission 02.

collectibles.name: Hilt of Gram
collectibles.method: Open the Temple of Light Legendary Chest containing the Hilt.

collectibles.name: Hilt of Hrotti
collectibles.method: Defeat any two of the three optional Oath Guards; the second defeated drops the Hilt.

collectibles.name: Motsognir’s Call
collectibles.method: After the story, take the new path left of The Raven Tree and collect the Relic left of the prison’s top-floor Legendary Chest.

collectibles.name: Hilt of Hofud
collectibles.method: Defeat Heimdall during Main Mission 13 and collect the story reward.

achievements.description: Craft the Dragon Scaled Armor Set
achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Craft the @item{Dragon Scaled Breastplate}, @item{Bracers}, and @item{Girdle} after completing a Crater Dragon Hunt.

guide.context: The first Dragon Hunt unlocks the set recipes. All nine Crater Hunts provide more Dragon materials during completion cleanup.

steps.text: Reach Vanaheim’s Crater through Scent of Survival and complete one Dragon Hunt to add the Dragon Scaled set at blacksmiths.
Collect at least 1 Dragon Claw and 22 Dragon Teeth from Dragon and Epic Hunts.
At a blacksmith, craft the Breastplate for 1 Claw and 2 Teeth, then the Bracers and Girdle for 10 Teeth each.

achievements.description: Fully repair the Amulet of Yggdrasil
achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Find @item{7 Jewels of Yggdrasil} and spend one at a blacksmith on each unrepaired Amulet slot.

guide.context: The Reckoning unlocks the nine-slot Amulet with two slots already open; missed story-drop Jewels move to the blue blacksmith chest.

collectibles.name: Frost Phantom Jewel
collectibles.method: Defeat the Frost Phantom and collect its Jewel; check the blue blacksmith chest if it was missed.

collectibles.name: Forge Ogre Jewel
collectibles.method: Defeat The Forge Ogre and collect its Jewel; check the blue blacksmith chest if it was missed.

collectibles.name: Elven Sanctum Jewel
collectibles.method: Open the upstairs Legendary Chest inside the northern Elven Sanctum.

collectibles.name: Alberich Island Jewel
collectibles.method: Complete The Lost Treasure and open the Legendary Chest at the island’s end.

collectibles.name: Oarsmen Jewel
collectibles.method: Pull the large chains, descend the revealed right staircase, and open the Legendary Chest.

collectibles.name: Noatunn’s Garden Jewel
collectibles.method: Chain Sigil Arrows and the Blades to burn the vines through the rear window, then break the exposed lock and open the chest.

collectibles.name: Jungle Jewel
collectibles.method: Drop into the dragon pit where Path of Destruction begins and open its Legendary Chest.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: After the story, complete @mechanic{A Viking Funeral} at Raeb’s tavern and @loc{Sverd Sands}.

guide.context: The Favor becomes available only after The Realms at War and serves as the base game’s epilogue.

steps.text: Speak to Lúnda at a blacksmith after the story, then enter Raeb’s tavern in Nidavellir and attend Brok’s wake.
Travel to Sverd Sands, reach the funeral boat, and complete the interaction at the shoreline.

achievements.description: Return the Hammer of the Rebellion
achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Spirit of Rebellion} by retrieving the Hammer of the Rebellion and returning it to Durlin.

guide.context: Durlin offers the Favor in Nidavellir’s tavern after Forging Destiny.

steps.text: From Dragon Beach, climb to Alberich Hollow’s bridge and read the rune slate at the giant dwarf statue to raise its hammer.
Collect the Hammer of the Rebellion from beneath the statue and deliver it to Durlin in the tavern.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{The Mysterious Orb} by finding Lúnda’s orb at The Veiled Passage and returning it to her.

guide.context: Lúnda offers the Favor at Freyr’s Camp after The Reckoning.

steps.text: Sail into The Veiled Passage and pick up the orb beside its boat landing.
Take the orb to Lúnda at the River Delta blacksmith and finish the conversation.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Free both @npc{Hafgufas} by completing @mechanic{Secret of the Sands} and @mechanic{Song of the Sands} in Alfheim.

guide.context: The first Hafgufa is beneath The Barrens; the second is beneath The Forbidden Sands and requires later story access.

steps.text: Enter The Below from The Barrens, destroy the Hafgufa’s underground bindings, return to the surface, and break its final hive cage.
Repeat the complete binding-and-cage sequence in The Burrows beneath The Forbidden Sands.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{The Weight of Chains} by cutting the Lyngbakr’s three fin chains and its final eye binding.

guide.context: Strike the Watchtower drum in Svartalfheim’s Bay of Bounty to raise Lyngbakr Island and begin the Favor.

steps.text: Land on Lyngbakr Island, climb through its opened routes, and sever all three chains attached to its fins.
Return to the boat, sail to the island’s southwest side, dock at the eye, and remove the final binding.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Freya’s Missing Peace} in Vanir Shrine and recover @item{Mardöll} with Freya.

guide.context: Sailing into the River Delta after The Reckoning starts the Favor. If the river is blocked, use Freyr’s Camp Celestial Altar to change Vanaheim to day.

steps.text: Sail to Vanir Shrine with Freya and open the route through its rune and bridge puzzles.
Collect Freya’s three marked belongings, including Mardöll, then complete the final shrine interaction.

achievements.description: Complete all of the Crater Hunts
achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Reach Vanaheim’s Crater and finish its @mechanic{9 Hunts}: seven are Dragon Hunts and two are Epic Hunts.

guide.context: Finish Creatures of Prophecy, follow Helka from Freyr’s Camp, and complete Scent of Survival before these nine Hunts appear on the Crater map.

collectibles.name: What Lies Below
collectibles.method: Complete the Dragon Hunt in The Jungle.

collectibles.name: Trail of the Dead
collectibles.method: Complete the Dragon Hunt in The Jungle.

collectibles.name: Path of Destruction
collectibles.method: Complete the Dragon Hunt that begins in the Jungle dragon pit.

collectibles.name: Quaking Hollow
collectibles.method: Complete the Dragon Hunt in The Sinkholes.

collectibles.name: The Burning Skies
collectibles.method: Complete the second Sinkholes Dragon Hunt.

collectibles.name: In the Dead of Night
collectibles.method: Complete The Plains Dragon Hunt at night.

collectibles.name: For Vanaheim!
collectibles.method: Complete the Crimson Dread Dragon Hunt.

collectibles.name: In Plain Sight
collectibles.method: Complete The Plains Epic Hunt.

collectibles.name: Nocturnal Predator
collectibles.method: Complete the nighttime Epic Hunt in The Plains.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Animal Instincts}, defeat @enemy{Olaf Nautson}, and pet @npc{Speki and Svanna}.

guide.context: Clearing any Kol Raider Camp around Midgard’s Lake of Nine starts the four-camp Favor.

steps.text: Clear all four Kol Raider Camps marked around the Lake of Nine.
Defeat chieftain Olaf Nautson, return to the sled, and interact with Speki and Svanna to finish the Favor.

achievements.description: Return all the Lindwyrms to Ratatoskr
achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Use Ratatoskr’s @item{Lindwyrm Trap} on all @mechanic{6 Yggdrasil Rifts}, then return the captured Lindwyrms.

guide.context: Ratatoskr gives the Trap at Sindri’s House after The Word of Fate; several Rifts require Draupnir traversal.

collectibles.name: The Forge Lindwyrm
collectibles.method: Use the Lindwyrm Trap on The Forge Yggdrasil Rift.

collectibles.name: Alberich Hollow Lindwyrm
collectibles.method: After defeating Ormstunga, capture the Lindwyrm from the ledge Rift.

collectibles.name: Alberich Island Lindwyrm
collectibles.method: Reach the platform between the islands and use the Trap on its Rift.

collectibles.name: Applecore Lindwyrm
collectibles.method: Use Draupnir to climb to The Applecore Gateway and capture the nearby Lindwyrm.

collectibles.name: Crimson Dread Lindwyrm
collectibles.method: Capture the Lindwyrm from the Rift in the Crimson Dread arena.

collectibles.name: Eastern Plains Lindwyrm
collectibles.method: Capture the Lindwyrm from the Rift near the eastern Celestial Altar.

achievements.description: Return the Stags of the Four Seasons
achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Reach Vanaheim’s Crater, collect @item{Yggdrasil Leaves} from Ratatoskr, and feed all @npc{4 seasonal stags}.

guide.context: Approaching a stag starts A Stag for All Seasons; Summer also requires Return of the River and daytime access.

collectibles.name: Stag of Winter
collectibles.method: Feed the stag beside the Overgrown Tower Mystic Gateway.

collectibles.name: Stag of Autumn
collectibles.method: Feed the stag beside the Sinkholes Entrance Mystic Gateway.

collectibles.name: Stag of Spring
collectibles.method: Enter the Wishing Well from The Sinkholes or The Jungle and feed the stag inside.

collectibles.name: Stag of Summer
collectibles.method: Complete Return of the River, change to day, defeat the ogres on their island, open the plant route, swing across, and feed the stag.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Collect both Muspelheim Seed Pieces and complete all @mechanic{15 Crucible trials}.

guide.context: The left, middle, and right side swords correspond to F, N, and R. Their ordered pairs determine which of the six Final Challenges appears at the central sword.

steps.text: Open the Legendary Chest at Modvitnir’s Rig for one Seed Piece. Find the other in Alberich Hollow’s Legendary Chest, then travel to The Crucible.
Complete both initial challenges at each side sword: F, N, and R.
After the central Nornir Chest opens, complete Rampage at the left F sword, Health Steal at the middle N sword, and Kill Fuse at the right R sword.
Use the six unique sequences F+N, N+R, F+R, R+F, N+F, and R+N; after each pair, complete the resulting central challenge.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Upgrade the chest, wrist, and waist pieces from one identically named armor set to @item{level 9}.

guide.context: Mixed armor pieces do not count. Full region cleanup supplies the high-grade materials needed for the last upgrades.

steps.text: Choose one complete three-piece set, such as the Fate Breaker Shoulder Guard, Wraps, and Belt.
At a blacksmith, purchase every upgrade for all three matching pieces until each displays level 9.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Odin, the All-Father} during @loc{The Realms at War}.

guide.context: The final campaign boss has no difficulty-specific condition.

steps.text: Complete the mandatory boss encounter and continue until the achievement notification appears.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Defeat all @enemy{12 Berserkers}, activate the final Gravestone at @loc{King’s Grave}, and defeat @enemy{King Hrólf Kraki}.

guide.context: Hrólf is level 9. Finish region cleanup first; Give Me Story difficulty, a Resurrection Stone, and Miniboss Checkpoints are permitted.

steps.text: Complete the nine Berserker Gravestones across Midgard, Svartalfheim, Alfheim, Vanaheim, and Niflheim.
Return to King’s Grave in Midgard, activate the final Gravestone, and win the King Hrólf fight to complete Fit for a King.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: After the story, find @enemy{Gná} beyond Muspelheim’s Crucible and defeat the Valkyrie Queen.

guide.context: Gná is a level-9 optional boss. Reach gear level 9 and buy a Resurrection Stone; no difficulty setting is required.

steps.text: From The Crucible arena, take the small right-side passage beyond the Asgard remnant and approach the diary at Gná’s camp.
Begin Defend Your Valor and defeat Gná to complete the Favor and register the achievement.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Finish Valhalla’s six story chapters by defeating @enemy{Týr} for the fourth time in @loc{Benevolence}.

guide.context: Valhalla is a separate title-screen mode with independent gear. Permanent Shore upgrades make later attempts easier.

steps.text: Advance through The Work, Part 3: Benevolence, defeat Týr for the fourth time, and complete the ending sequence.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Start @loc{Valhalla}, die during the first attempt, and watch the Shore cutscene that completes @loc{The Invitation}.

guide.context: The first death is mandatory progression and begins the next Valhalla cycle.

steps.text: Enter Valhalla from the title screen, allow the first run to end in death, and continue through the automatic Shore cutscene.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Reach @npc{Helios} and complete the mandatory @mechanic{Sacrifice} during Valhalla’s third attempt or later.

guide.context: The Sacrifice ends the current run and completes Chapter 2, Homecoming.

steps.text: Progress through enough realms to meet Helios, follow the forced Sacrifice sequence, and return to The Shore.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Reach @enemy{Týr} during Valhalla’s fourth attempt or later, defeat him, and leave through the exit gate.

guide.context: This first Týr victory completes Chapter 3, The Host, and opens the next story cycle.

steps.text: Complete the run to Týr, win the boss fight, then use the exit gate so the chapter completion registers.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: After the first Týr victory, collect @item{Kratos’s Oath Stone} during @loc{The Work, Part I: Acceptance}.

guide.context: The glowing Oath Stone is a forced pickup on the route toward the second Týr battle.

steps.text: Start the next story run, continue through its realms, and pick up the mandatory glowing Oath Stone when the route presents it.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Visit all @loc{9 Valhalla realms}, finishing one run apiece with the Axe, Blades, and Spear perk from the first chest.

guide.context: Six realms are random. The other three are fixed penultimate realms selected by the starting weapon perk and cannot appear randomly.

steps.text: On separate attempts, choose the Axe, Blades, and Spear bonuses from the first chest and finish each run far enough to enter its weapon-specific realm.
Continue Valhalla story and cleanup attempts until the remaining six randomly selected realms have all appeared.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: During @loc{Benevolence}, collect @item{Pandora’s Statue} on the mandatory route toward the fourth Týr battle.

guide.context: The pickup can occur on the seventh attempt at the earliest, after three previous Týr victories.

steps.text: Advance through The Work, Part 3: Benevolence and take Pandora’s Statue when the story route presents it.

achievements.description: Participate in a fight at The Forum arena
achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: After finishing Benevolence, defeat @enemy{7 Chosen}, enter @loc{The Forum} in the Greek fog maze, and complete one arena match.

guide.context: The Forum is the third arena and unlocks after the fourth Týr victory; the first two arenas are not prerequisites.

steps.text: Complete the six-chapter Valhalla story by defeating Týr four times.
On a later run, defeat seven Chosen in the fog maze and climb to the upstairs central Forum entrance.
Start one Forum match and complete its encounter to register the achievement.

achievements.description: Acquire more than 15,000 Fleeting Echoes on a single attempt
achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Hold more than @item{15,000 Fleeting Echoes} during one Valhalla attempt.

guide.context: Echoes do not accumulate between attempts. Seven Chosen plus The Forum comfortably pass the threshold; all Chosen plus two earlier arenas is an alternative.

steps.text: Defeat every available Chosen in the Greek fog maze to raise the run’s score multiplier.
Complete The Forum or two earlier arenas without ending the attempt, and continue until the held Fleeting Echo total exceeds 15,000.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: Finish @mechanic{9 Mastery Quests} under Goals > Mastery and report each completion to the Valkyries at The Shore.

guide.context: There are 24 Masteries and more unlock with story progress. Completed objectives do not count until the Shore hand-in.

steps.text: Open Goals > Mastery and work through the three Rage and three Shield Masteries by rotating those loadout choices between attempts.
Complete any three additional Masteries, such as Travel Mastery, Greek Labyrinth Mastery, and Permanent Upgrade Mastery.
Speak with the Valkyries at The Shore after finished objectives until nine Mastery Quests show as completed.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: At @loc{The Shore}, use the yellow appearance pillar and equip any Cosmetic Armor.

guide.context: The pillar becomes usable after the first death and the following run; cosmetic armor changes appearance without changing attributes.

steps.text: Die on the first attempt, complete the following run, and return to The Shore.
Before starting another attempt, interact with the yellow glowing pillar and equip any cosmetic armor appearance.

achievements.sortReason: Grouped with the relevant cleanup stage.
achievements.summary: After reclaiming Pandora’s Statue, collect all @item{3 Boat Captain Keys} from the first Valhalla chamber.

guide.context: One purple key appears beside the first chest and painting per subsequent successful run; another spawns only after the run is completed.

steps.text: Begin the attempt after reclaiming Pandora’s Statue. In the opening chamber, take the purple key from the painting area beside the first reward chest.
Defeat Týr to complete the run, then repeat the same first-chamber pickup and successful finish twice more.
